entries.zh: 陪巡；陪同视察／探望被访者
entries.en: to accompany someone on a visit (to visit the visited)

entries.zh: 陪隨；紧随不离地陪同
entries.en: to accompany without leaving, to stay alongside

entries.zh: 隨；跟随、伴随
entries.en: to follow, to accompany

entries.zh: 隨帶；随身携带、带着（随行）
entries.en: to bring along, to carry in one's train

entries.zh: 隨從；随从、跟随（仆役随行）
entries.en: to follow as retinue, to attend (a person)

entries.zh: 隨跟；像仆人一样紧跟着（先生、主人）
entries.en: to follow closely after a master, as a servant

entries.zh: 隨護；随行护卫、护送
entries.en: to escort, to accompany protectively

entries.zh: 送；送行、陪同前往
entries.en: to escort, to see off, to accompany

entries.zh: 輔；辅佐、辅助
entries.en: to assist, to aid (as minister)

entries.zh: 輔佐；在政务上辅佐（君主、长官）
entries.en: to assist in government, to serve as counselor

entries.zh: 輔弼；辅弼（重臣之职，辅佐君王）
entries.en: to assist and support (the ruler), as chief minister

entries.zh: 送；送、奉送（送别／送物）
entries.en: to send, to deliver, to accompany

entries.zh: 送親；送亲——陪新娘出门至门口／送嫁
entries.en: to escort the bride (to accompany her out to the gate)

entries.zh: 送葬；送葬、随灵柩送至坟地
entries.en: to accompany the dead (to funeral), to follow the coffin to burial

entries.zh: 行程；同行上路、随行一程
entries.en: to travel together (share a journey, go part of the way with)
entries.notes: 西语 acompañar 对『行程』按字面为旅程义，此处取随行一程义，依赖四栏互证的推断

entries.zh: 𤆬；引路、带领〔原件该字残缺难辨〕
entries.en: to lead the way, to guide 〔character partly illegible〕
entries.notes: 汉字栏为 [疑:焦/炰/𤆬]，闽南语 chhōa（𤆬）义为领路带领，最贴合 acompañar 语境

entries.zh: 𤆬嫁；陪送出嫁、送嫁娘〔首字残缺难辨〕
entries.en: to escort the bride at her wedding, to accompany the newlyweds
entries.notes: 首字同 16 为 [疑]，以 en『acompañar los desposados』定释义为送嫁

entries.zh: 轿后人；轿后随行的人（如侍从扶轿随行）
entries.en: those walking behind the sedan chair, to attend it as an esquire

entries.zh: 絆；绊、随行相伴（亦含绊住不离义）
entries.en: to keep alongside, to stay by (lit. to entangle, to hold back)
entries.notes: 絆本义绊住；对 acompañar 取相伴不离义，依赖语境推断

entries.zh: 徇；顺从、依从（劝告）
entries.en: to comply with, to follow (advice)
entries.notes: 西语 aconsejar 为『劝告』，徇本义顺从；此处按受词角度取『听从劝告』，语向依赖推断

entries.zh: 點醒；点醒、提醒、开导
entries.en: to awaken (someone) by pointing out, to admonish, to give advice

entries.zh: 失點檢；失于点检——疏忽提醒／没有检点（劝诫义）
entries.en: to fail to keep account (omit the due reminder/scrutiny)
entries.notes: 『失點檢』罕见组合，字面为疏于点检；对 [acon]sejar（词头首字残缺）取劝诫义，语义依赖推断，故降低置信
